Welcome to The Glen Mhor Book A Room Book A Table Experience the beauty of Inverness Located in a conservation area of city centre Inverness, we pride ourselves on blending the timeless charm of Highland stays with a commitment to a greener tomorrow. Our recent £7.5 million investment in an autonomous energy centre, water system and ‘Brewstillery’ is a testament to our dedication to sustainability. As the proud home of the first distillery & brewery in Inverness in over 130 years, we are at the forefront of revitalising the city’s rich distilling history. With Distillery/Brewery Tours available daily and a range of activities, there’s always something to do at the Glen Mhor Hotel. Choosing The Glen Mhor means you’re not only getting a serene retreat surrounded by the rich history and beauty of the Highlands, but you’re also contributing to a fairer, greener, and brighter tomorrow Book Now Latest Special Offers Stay and Save Enjoy comfortable stays for less when you book direct Save up to 15% on bookings of 2 nights or more. The perfect way to extend your getaway without extending your budget. Find Out More The Ultimate Highland Escape Experience the heart of Inverness with an unforgettable Dinner, Bed & Breakfast getaway, topped with a journey through the brand-new Inverness Castle Experience. Find Out More Winter Escape Escape the chill with an all-inclusive stay. Cosyness, dining, and comfort - sorted. The Ultimate Winter Escape, Dinner, Bed & Breakfast from just £119! Find Out More Sunday Roast & Recharge Why let the weekend end on Sunday afternoon? Extend your escape with our "Roast & Recharge" package. Enjoy a traditional, locally sourced Sunday Roast for two, followed by a relaxing overnight stay and a hearty breakfast to kickstart your Monday. Find Out More Rooms & Apartments The Glen Mhor Hotel offers 110 bedrooms across 10 Victorian buildings along with 11 self-contained apartments. Our mission is to provide an exceptional guest experience while leaving a positive impact on our planet and community. Our Rooms Our Apartments Stay with us Dine with us Dining & Drinks Experience the Best of Highland Hospitality. Nestled within the scenic grounds of The Glen Mhor Hotel, the Uile-bheist Restaurant is a culinary gem that invites guests on a delightful journey of taste and ambience.
